title: Use FlatList/SectionList for long lists
guideline: Never map() a large array directly into ScrollView; use virtualized list components

title: Respect safe areas on notched devices
guideline: Wrap screens in SafeAreaView or use safe-area-context insets for status bar/notch/home indicator

title: Give touchables clear pressed feedback
guideline: Use Pressable with a visible pressed style rather than TouchableOpacity with no feedback

title: Cache and size remote images deliberately
guideline: Set explicit width/height and use a caching image component for remote images

title: Structure navigation with stack + tab navigators
guideline: Combine React Navigation stack and tab navigators to match common mobile IA patterns

title: Account for platform differences deliberately
guideline: Use Platform.select/OS checks for intentional iOS/Android differences, not accidental ones

title: Handle the keyboard covering form inputs
guideline: Wrap forms in KeyboardAvoidingView so inputs aren't hidden behind the keyboard
